FROM (SELECT PARSE_JSON(MAX(v)) AS doc FROM json_projection.t0) s
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM json_projection.t0) a
CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM json_projection.t0) b
